notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.audit_log_synced: Audit log synced to Saved Messages.
notifications.audit_log_sync_desc: Kept in your own Telegram Saved Messages too (last 30 days) so it survives a lost or reinstalled device.

settings.title: Settings
settings.telegram_creds_desc: Required for every cloud feature (streaming, backup, sharing) to reach Telegram at all. Get these from my.telegram.org if you don't have them yet.
settings.telegram_creds_required: Enter both an API ID and API Hash.
settings.telegram_creds_invalid: API ID must be numbers only, with no spaces in either field.
settings.google_description: Sign in with Google to remember your Telegram API ID/Hash across devices, via a hidden folder in your own Google Drive. Your Telegram login itself is never stored there.
settings.google_client_desc: One-time setup: paste the OAuth Client ID/Secret from your Google Cloud Console project.
settings.google_client_required: Both the Client ID and Client Secret are required.
settings.google_client_save_failed: Could not save Google Client credentials: {{error}}
settings.google_connecting: Waiting for sign-in in your browser…
settings.app_lock_description: A second, local unlock screen shown every time you open the app — on top of whatever login you use above. Set with a one-time email code, checked offline afterward.
settings.smtp_desc: Uses your own Gmail account to deliver the verification code below. Create an "App Password" at myaccount.google.com/apppasswords (requires 2-Step Verification).
settings.smtp_required: Both the Gmail address and App Password are required.
settings.app_lock_disabled_desc: App Lock is set up but currently off.
settings.app_lock_needs_smtp: Set up the email sender above first.
settings.webdav_description: Open Telegram Drive in Finder, File Explorer, or another WebDAV client.
settings.webdav_local_only: The server listens only on this computer (127.0.0.1).
settings.webdav_allow_changes_desc: Allow WebDAV clients to upload, rename, move, and delete unencrypted files. Leave off for safer read-only access.
settings.webdav_link_configured: Secure link configured. Regenerate it if you no longer have a copy.
settings.webdav_link_unset: Generate a private connection link before enabling the server.
settings.webdav_copy_alert: Copy now — this private link will not be shown again
settings.webdav_changes_enabled: Current access: file changes are allowed
settings.webdav_mobile_unavailable: WebDAV hosting is available in the macOS, Windows, and Linux desktop apps.
settings.webdav_regenerate_desc: The current connection link will stop working immediately. You will need to reconnect every WebDAV client with the new link.
settings.webdav_enable_changes_confirm: Connected WebDAV clients will be able to upload, rename, move, and delete unencrypted files. Encrypted files remain protected.
settings.backup_all_desc: One click to protect Desktop, Documents, and Pictures — calculates the size first and asks you to approve before anything uploads.
settings.backup_all_calculated: Calculated — check the notification bell to approve.
settings.backup_exclude_desc: Anything checked here is skipped entirely, including everything inside an excluded folder.
settings.autostart_desc: Launch at login and keep running when you close the window, so scheduled backups fire even on a day you never open the app. Use the tray icon to reopen or fully quit.
settings.backup_description: Protect local folders by mirroring them into your own Telegram storage — unlimited, since it rides on your Telegram account rather than a separate quota.
settings.backup_schedule_disabled: Daily backup is turned off — use Backup Now instead.
settings.backup_no_folders: No folders protected yet. Add one to get started.
settings.backup_folder_enabled: Include this folder in scheduled backups
settings.backup_remove_desc: "{{name}}" will stop being backed up. Files already uploaded to Telegram are kept — this only stops future backups.
settings.backup_now_partial: Backup finished with issues — {{uploaded}} uploaded, {{failed}} failed
settings.backup_pick_folder_title: Select a folder to back up
settings.backup_pick_destination_title: Back up to which Telegram folder?
settings.backup_create_new_destination: Create a new folder for this
settings.backup_cancelling: Stopping after the current file finishes…
settings.backup_restore_confirm_desc: Restore "{{name}}" into {{path}}. Existing files with the same size are skipped; everything else is overwritten.
settings.backup_restore_success: Restore complete — {{restored}} restored, {{skipped}} already up to date
settings.backup_restore_partial: Restore finished with issues — {{restored}} restored, {{failed}} failed
settings.totp_desc: Once set up, reopening the app on this or a new device just needs a 6-digit code from your phone — no more re-entering your phone number and SMS code. Works with any standard authenticator app (Microsoft Authenticator, Google Authenticator, Authy, etc.).
settings.totp_scan_instructions: Scan this with your authenticator app, then enter the code it shows to confirm.
settings.totp_setup_key_warning: You'll need this exact key to link a new device later — save it somewhere safe now, it won't be shown again after this.
settings.totp_enabled: Authenticator is set up on this device
settings.totp_setup_success: Authenticator set up — future logins on this device just need a code.
settings.totp_disable_desc: You'll need to redo a full phone/code login next time you sign out on this device.
settings.delete_theme_confirm: Are you sure you want to delete this custom theme?
settings.linux_rendering_desc: Disable DMA-BUF renderer (fixes GPU crashes, requires restart)
settings.enable_api_server_desc: Start API server to access files programmatically
settings.api_copy_alert: Copy now — this key will not be shown again
settings.transcode_cache_desc: Max disk space for HLS variants
settings.enable_proxy_desc: Route traffic through a proxy server
settings.socks5_desc: SOCKS5 proxy (MTProto not supported by grammers)
settings.proxy_reconnect_note: ⚠️ Proxy changes require reconnecting to take effect.
settings.http_bridge_desc: HTTP/HTTPS proxy tunneling via local SOCKS5 bridge.
settings.live_state_desc: Periodically check connectivity and display latency
settings.storage_cap_desc: Total upload + download allowed per day before transfers are blocked. Resets at midnight.
settings.storage_cap_save_failed: Could not update the storage cap: {{error}}
settings.dc_fallback_desc: DCs to try on connection failure
settings.bulk_archive_desc: Max RAM for API archive downloads
settings.ip_override_desc: Automatically replaces '127.0.0.1:14201' with this IP/domain when copying.
settings.relay_desc: Lets single-file share links keep working even when this PC is off, via a Telegram bot + a small free relay you deploy once. Set up: see app/cloudflare-worker/README.md.
settings.relay_setup_help: One-time setup: create a bot via @BotFather, deploy the Worker in app/cloudflare-worker (see its README), then paste the values above.
settings.relay_bot_save_failed: Could not save the bot token: {{error}}
settings.relay_worker_save_failed: Could not save the relay configuration: {{error}}
settings.no_active_links_desc: Right-click any file and select "Share Link" to create one.
settings.tagline: Turn your Telegram account into unlimited, secure cloud storage. Open-source and free forever.
settings.clear_local_cache_desc: Remove cached previews and temp files
settings.clear_cache_desc: This will remove all cached previews and temporary files. Your uploaded files on Telegram are not affected.
settings.clear_transcode_message: This will delete all transcoded HLS variants and cached originals. Files will need to be re-transcoded for HLS playback.
settings.check_updates_desc: Check if a newer version exists
settings.update_prod_only_toast: Update check is only available in production builds
settings.revoke_link_desc: Are you sure you want to revoke this link? Anyone using it will no longer be able to download the file.
settings.regenerate_api_key_desc: This will revoke your current API key and generate a new one. Any existing integrations will stop working.
settings.generate_api_key_desc: Generate a new API key for authenticating REST API requests.
settings.restart_app_toast: Restart the app for this change to take effect
settings.reconnect_success_toast: Reconnected successfully with new proxy settings
settings.encryption_unavailable: Encryption is not available in this build.
settings.encryption_backend_error: The encryption service did not respond. You may be running an older or stale app process.
settings.encryption_safety_pause_title: Encrypted transfers are paused for safety
settings.encryption_safety_pause_body: Standard transfers remain available. Encrypted uploads and decryption are disabled while the corrected file format and persistent vault are completed.
settings.encryption_disabled: Encryption is turned off. Standard transfers remain available.
settings.encryption_experimental_inventory_one: One experimental encrypted file is indexed locally. Its ciphertext has been preserved.
settings.encryption_experimental_inventory_other: {{count}} experimental encrypted files are indexed locally. Their ciphertext has been preserved.
settings.encryption_disclaimer_body: Telegram Drive cannot recover or reset forgotten passphrases, encryption keys, or recovery material. If you lose every credential that can unlock a file, that file may become permanently inaccessible. Store recovery material securely, keep a verified backup, and never share credentials with anyone you do not trust.
settings.encryption_disclaimer_acknowledgement: I understand that I am responsible for safeguarding my encryption credentials, and that losing every valid credential may permanently prevent access to my encrypted files.
settings.encryption_ack_required: Please acknowledge the encryption key-loss warning before creating a vault.
settings.default_upload_protection_desc: Choose how new files are protected by default
settings.protect_metadata_desc: Hide original filename and MIME type
settings.lock_on_sleep_desc: Lock vault when app enters background
settings.temp_plaintext_policy_desc: Strict mode blocks temp files on disk
settings.vault_create_prompt: Create a vault to enable encrypted uploads. Choose a strong passphrase you can remember.
settings.recovery_key_warning: Store this key securely. It cannot be recovered if lost.
settings.vault_is_unlocked: Vault is unlocked. Files can be encrypted and decrypted.
settings.vault_is_locked: Vault is locked. Unlock to access encrypted files.
settings.min_passphrase_length: Passphrase must be at least 8 characters
settings.export_recovery_desc: Create an encrypted backup of your vault key. Keep this bundle safe.
settings.bundle_warning: Store this bundle securely. It contains your encrypted vault key. Never share it.
settings.import_recovery_desc: Restore your vault from an encrypted recovery bundle.
settings.import_recovery_confirmation: Importing a recovery bundle will replace the current vault after the bundle and passphrase are verified. Continue?

files.no_other_folders: No other folders available. Create one first!
files.url_must_start: URL must start with http:// or https://
files.transfers_queue_desc: Downloads and uploads are safely queued and managed in the background.
files.drop_browser_help: Use the desktop app for file drops, or open the upload dialog instead.

notifications.drop_rejected_one: {{count}} dropped item was skipped. Drop regular files or use Upload Folder.
notifications.drop_rejected_other: {{count}} dropped items were skipped. Drop regular files or use Upload Folder.

share.title: Share File
share.always_on: Always-on (works when your PC is off)
share.always_on_desc: Uses a Telegram bot relay instead of this computer. Needs one-time setup in Settings → Sharing.
share.always_on_needs_folder: Only available for files inside a folder (not Saved Messages).
share.always_on_setup_note: Requires a bot + relay already configured in Settings → Sharing → Always-on links. Files over 20MB aren't supported (a Telegram Bot API limit).
share.always_on_link_created: Always-on link created — works even when your PC is off.
share.tailscale_help: To share with someone else on your Tailscale network or local WiFi, enter your machine's IP address or hostname below:

temp_link.title: Generate Temp Link
temp_link.tunnel_checking: Checking whether this link works from other devices…
temp_link.tunnel_public: This link works from any device, anywhere.
temp_link.tunnel_local_only: Public link unavailable right now — this only works on this computer. Try again in a moment, or use the field below.
temp_link.no_permissions_warning: Choose at least one permission to continue.
temp_link.permission_warning: Anyone with this link can {{permissions}} in "{{folder}}" — no login required.
temp_link.no_password_warning: This link grants write access with no password. Consider adding one.
temp_link.username_desc: If set, whoever opens the link must enter both this username and the password above.
temp_link.username_share_reminder: Share this username along with the link and password — it isn't stored anywhere else.
temp_link.copy_failed: Could not copy the link to your clipboard.

auth.desktop_required_desc: You are viewing the internal development server in a browser. This application cannot function here because it requires access to the system backend (Rust).
auth.open_window_prompt: Please open the Telegram Drive window in your OS taskbar/dock to continue.
auth.flood_wait_msg: Telegram has temporarily limited your actions.
auth.timer_reset_warning: Do not restart the app. The timer will reset if you do.
auth.how_to_get_credentials: How do I get my API credentials?
auth.two_factor_enabled: Your account has Two-Factor Authentication enabled. Please enter your cloud password to continue.
auth.privacy_note: Your credentials are stored locally on your device and are never sent to any third-party servers. All data goes directly between you and Telegram.

ads.sponsor_message: A quick message from our sponsor
ads.sponsor_support_desc: Visiting the sponsor helps support development and keeps Telegram Drive available at no cost.
ads.browser_note: Sponsored content opens in your browser. You only see this gateway once.
